sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Explore Trellis's advanced ad configuration options to fine-tune performance, customize optimization behavior, and control how your campaigns learn, harvest, and scale.

sections.heading: What Advanced Settings Help You Do
sections.body: Trellis offers a range of advanced settings that give experienced advertisers greater control over how their campaigns operate. These tools help you refine how keywords and ASINs are discovered and harvested, adjust bid behavior to balance growth and profitability, and customize campaign automation, pacing, and placement strategies.

sections.heading: Where to Find Advanced Settings
sections.body: You can access all of these options under Configuration -> Campaign Settings -> Advanced Settings within any Media Plan.

sections.heading: Advanced Features Reference
sections.body:
Discovery & Harvesting: Enables Trellis to analyze target data to discover new keywords and ASINs. Includes Auto Campaigns, Keyword Harvesting, and ASIN Harvesting settings. Use when you want Trellis to expand targeting automatically and learn which keywords drive conversions.

Optimization Strategies: Choose how Trellis manages bids within your ACOS range. Options include ROAS Boost, GrowthMax, Product Launch, and Only Rules. Use to control whether campaigns focus on profitability, growth, or manual rule logic.

Match Types & Tunneling: Defines how closely your ads match customer search queries using Exact, Phrase, and Broad. Trellis uses tunneling to automatically shift spend from Broad to Phrase to Exact as performance improves. Use to balance reach and efficiency while letting Trellis focus spend on high-performing keywords.

Bid Ranges: Set minimum and maximum bids to ensure bids remain within the range that you prefer. Use to control how the system adjusts your bids up and down.

Rule Programs: Set up Rule Programs to customize the behavior of bids and campaign changes. Use to control how the system is bidding based on your custom rulesets.

Manage Dayparting within Trellis: Set up hourly bidding multipliers based on daily and hourly campaign data. Use to customize when you show up for customers throughout the day.

Auto Harvesting and Negation Rules: Customize thresholds for harvesting new keywords and automatically remove poor-performing search terms or ASINs to optimize efficiency. Use to tighten or loosen when new keywords are added based on your data volume.

Amazon Options and Placement Multipliers: Choose between Amazon's Up/Down, Fixed, or Down Only bidding logic and update placement multipliers. Use to fine-tune how Amazon modifies bids during auctions.

sections.heading: Best Practices
sections.body:
Start simple, then layer in advanced settings: Trellis performs best when it can gather baseline data before multiple advanced rules interact.

Review results weekly: Many advanced features, like harvesting or budget split, evolve over 1 to 2 weeks as data accumulates.

Keep ACOS ranges realistic: Overly tight ranges can restrict learning or limit Discovery efficiency.

Document changes: Note configuration updates in annotations on Trellis to track impact.

sections.heading: Other Access Paths
sections.body: You can also find advanced features under Advertising Dashboard -> Select Campaign -> Configuration -> Advanced Settings. Alternatively, you can view and edit multiple campaigns at once using Reports -> Ad Report -> Bulk Actions.
